native_to_julia_mapping.reason: Same iterative per-prefix DFS, non-short-circuit legality scans, source prefix partition/order, fixed private20-byte board and true integer counts. Native unroll hints/private-array lowering versus Julia MVector remain code-generation differences.

shared_benchmark_traits.timing_scope: One full all-prefix GPU DFS launch and device-wide completion; prefix generation/input copies/checks excluded
keyconfounds: Full original source case N15/depth7 is retained, all1897702 source prefixes and complete suffix search. Source repeat100 is measurement repetition, reduced to one full search per trial after one explicit feasibility probe, before primary measurements. One warmup then five in-process trials, mean last four.

Historical Julia file included unrelated mcpr, so previous PASS is not queens evidence. Actual iterative DFS/legality/private-board helper was restored and validated in the reference phase; portable indexed wrappers reuse that separately costed work.

Original source CPU prefix generation/order/UInt32 controls/first7 Int8 columns are preserved and checked against independent bitmask prefix enumeration. Five unused root-board bytes are zero-defined only for canonical input bytes, not a repair to read arithmetic. Source GPU reads only first7 prefix columns.

The source host reserves75580635 roots and output entries; named harness allocates only actual prefix capacity outside timing. Native device kernel/source unchanged. Original entire CLI allocation/host prefix generation time is not measured or certified as full end-to-end application performance.

Every prefix UInt64 subtree-node and solution count is checked against independent recursive bitmask enumeration, plus all source global totals. No solution-board output buffer exists; count evidence is not falsely described as exported solution boards.

Tree_size counts accepted legal search nodes, not attempted columns, failed legality comparisons, instructions or divergence. Prefix size CV0.656 is descriptive irregularity, not a measured warp-idle or bottleneck cause; even zero accepted-node subtrees attempt candidates.

Native private char[20] and Julia StaticArrays.MVector{20,Int8} retain fixed-size signed-byte DFS state; Julia immutable QueenRoot UInt32+12Int8 matches16-byte native ABI. Physical scalar replacement/local spills/stack/register effects are unknown.

Native UInt64 shift literals narrow into stored UInt32 control masks; Julia uses UInt32 shifts for selected columns0..14, algebraically identical for this case. UInt64 counters remain real UInt64, no floating-point emulation.

Native pragma-unroll2 hints differ from Julia loop lowering; framework indices may have different integer widths and address lowering. Same128-lane block/grid, one prefix per lane, no block synchronization or atomics. Profiling is needed for causal explanations.

Integer legality tests, bit masks, control flow and private DFS storage are not ordinary floating-point FLOP roofline work. Counter/operation and integer-ceiling conventions are needed; no measured roofline position inferred.

Only N15/depth7 is certified. General parameters must satisfy source root-board12/private-board20/shift/index limits; no arbitrary-size or64-bit-board capability claim and no framework-unsupported claim.

All CUDA.jl/KA/JACC kernels use own framework index APIs and standard StaticArrays/pure Julia search helpers, no foreign CUDA device intrinsic. CUDA host allocation/completion is tested only on NVIDIA, not cross-vendor portability.

First KA verifier preflight rejected a corrected metadata input-contract string before Julia launched; restoring archived text with an explicit hash-bound prose erratum fixed metadata. No target program revision/compiler failure. Actual first KA/JACC candidates each reach one successful device-JIT check, no repairs.

KA translation usage window also includes descriptive CPU subtree-statistics work and metadata preflight handling; it is not exclusive kernel-code consumption. Reference/helper/native/annotation costs separate; context/cache/coordination and overlapping broad/child windows are not exclusive billed cost.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Count all placements of15 nonattacking queens and all accepted search-tree nodes using CPU-generated depth7 prefixes and independent GPU suffix DFS tasks. No game engine or physical simulation application is implied.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Assign one column per row, requiring distinct columns and |column_i−column_j|!=|i−j|. Exhaustively count solutions and accepted legal partial placements under source lexicographic DFS ordering.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: Implicit irregular constraint-search tree on15×15 board, partitioned into1897702 legal depth7 prefix roots, one root per GPU lane.
invariants: Every prefix is legal, UInt32 control equals OR of its seven column bits, unused five fields zero-defined.
Complete prefix enumeration/order equals independently generated bitmask prefixes, with2466109 accepted prefix-tree nodes.
Every GPU suffix-tree/solution count exactly equals independent bitmask enumeration; source totals2279184 solutions/171129071 complete accepted nodes.
All20 artifact bytes exact, including every actual root and every UInt64 output count.
accuracy_requirements: All3795404 per-prefix UInt64 output values checked exactly, plus exact30363232 input bytes serialized as3795404 UInt64 words.
Independent CPU bitmask recursion differs from source per-column legality scanning; global source constants are supplemental only.
No floating-point tolerance or Float64 surrogate for root bits/count storage; all outputs finite by integer type.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Integer bitwidth, signed −1 board sentinel, exact mask/backtracking and count semantics; not floating roundoff. Selected15/depth7 respects native fixed board/root limits.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original N15/depth7, every source prefix, exhaustive suffix search; one full search/trial. Other sizes/depths and whole host workflow unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Combinatorial counting/constraint programming and irregular parallel tree-search benchmark; no identified physics or application dataset.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Accepted-node count distribution is a workload descriptor, not total attempted work, branch divergence, occupancy or measured instruction cost. Private-state/register/stack lowering unprofiled.
